requestedChanges: Align both right-side conclusions to one vertical axis
prompts:
Edit this provided COMPLETE Chinese historical game UI image. The user has SELECTED this exact image's art direction. Preserve the existing image's 16:9 framing, all scenery, character silhouette at lower left, military camp, upper-right lamplit tent, distant dark mountains, grey silk texture, ivory/grey/cinnabar palette and hand-painted material style. Make ONLY a precise UI layout and typography refinement. Do not redesign the artwork, do not zoom, do not crop, do not enlarge UI to fill available space.

THREE REQUIRED CHANGES:
1. Uniform smaller KAISHU 楷体 lettering. All text must remain the same refined regular-weight Kaishu face. Use ONLY TWO modest sizes: body/clues/descriptions around 16–17px high in this approximately 1672px-wide image; current question AND BOTH right-hand conclusions around 20–21px high. At a 1440px laptop these correspond approximately to 14px and 18px. Reduce the original large question and large “向姜维请求接报” SIGNIFICANTLY. Crucially “今夜有变，可能试探” in the upper right and “向姜维请求接报” in the lower right must have EXACTLY THE SAME glyph height, stroke weight, warm ivory color and letter spacing. No bold, no Songti, no oversized calligraphy. Small matching button text, unobtrusive header/footer.

2. Compact vertical rhythm. At this 1672x940 image size, put the earlier LEFT three clue baselines around y=145,183,221, with the earlier RIGHT conclusion around y=183. Put the current question around y=300, then current three clue baselines around y=345,383,421. Place “＋ 添入线索” and the compact “推理” button on one baseline around y=481. The expanded 2x2 selection slip is anchored immediately below, approximately y=510–615, width about 480px, compact two rows. This is a real rearrangement of spacing, not simply smaller text in the old widely spaced positions. Earlier group bottom and next question only about 70px apart, no huge mid-screen void. Maintain calm negative space below these compact groups.

3. ONE ALIGNED RIGHT-HAND COLUMN. Reposition the lower conclusion LEFT and UP so its first character “向” is EXACTLY on the same x-coordinate as the first character “今” of the upper conclusion. Use x approximately 945px as the text left edge for BOTH right conclusions. Upper outcome at y=183; lower outcome at y=383. Align their surrounding subtle ink-wash starting edges too. Both conclusions use a matching quiet, slender faded ink wash; lower one may have only a very faint local warm reveal glow. Do not make the lower conclusion a large headline or an independent hero card. Place its two supporting text lines below at y=425 and y=449, and “去见姜维” below at y=493, ALL on the SAME x=945 left alignment. This makes previous thought and next thought read as one continuous vertically aligned chain. Do NOT add a straight direct arrow between them: their semantic continuity is already represented by the curved carry-through to the next fixed clue.

Preserve exact content:
Earlier left:
“前几夜，闻号即退”
“今夜，闻号不退”
“随我军调动换向”
Earlier right:
“今夜有变，可能试探”
Current question:
“不惊扰丞相，军情该交给谁？”
Current left:
“今夜有变，可能试探” — mandatory inherited clue with a somewhat lighter grey fibre wash, NO ×
“今夜不得入帐” — tiny translucent × immediately at the end
“伯约受命接报” — tiny translucent × immediately at the end
Current right:
“向姜维请求接报”
“先请他在帐外听报。”
“是否应允，仍须当面问准。”
“去见姜维”
Controls “＋ 添入线索” and “推理”.
Expanded choice slip four entries in 2 columns:
“敌骑尚未攻营” “敌军探问发令者”
“亲兵可通传” “递话，不能决断”
each with tiny same-row plus.
Header “思绪” and “收起”; footer “回看前文” and “回到最新”.

Connections: keep delicate light grey curves. Three previous input threads merge before the upper right conclusion. One continuous light shallow curve LEAVES the bottom-left of the upper right conclusion, travels through the inter-round whitespace, skirts around the right side of the current question without touching it, and terminates EXACTLY at the RIGHT EDGE of the current fixed input “今夜有变，可能试探”. Never terminate it at the question or red mark. Three short thin curves from the current three inputs merge just before the left edge of the lower right conclusion at x=920, y=383. No crossing words, no long straight timeline, no additional arrows or large node dots.

Keep aligned left column at roughly x=490, and right column x=945. Clue strips are understated fibre/ink textures, not framed rectangles and not horizontal rules. Keep selection slip and button in the existing style but scale them down with the typography and vertical rhythm. This edit must visibly feel MORE COMPACT, SMALLER-TYPE, AND GEOMETRICALLY DISCIPLINED while preserving exactly the approved artistic mood. No extra text, no new props, no promotional annotations.

请精确编辑这张完整游戏 UI 图，只调整文字与控件的几何排版。背景军营、人物、光照、绢布纹理、配色完全保留，不重画成另一种风格。

现在最明显的错误：右上“今夜有变，可能试探”从约 x=950 开始，右下“向姜维请求接报”却从约 x=1050 开始，根本没有上下对齐。请务必把右下整组（标题、两行解释、“去见姜维”）向左移动约100像素，全部改成 x=950 起笔，与上方“今夜有变，可能试探”完全相同的左边缘。上下两个结论也必须采用完全相同的小号楷体、字号、字重，使用当前上面那个较小的字号。下方不再做大标题。两块文字底下的浅墨底纹也从同一条竖线起始。绝对不能再保留下方靠右的旧位置。

把下半轮整体向上收紧：问题从 y=365 上移到 y=300；三条线索分别以 y=350、390、430 为中心；“添入线索”和“推理”控件移到 y=490；下方展开的选择栏整体移到 y=525～625，压成两个紧凑的行。右下结论以 y=390 为基线，对齐左边中间那条“今夜不得入帐”。解释两行放在 y=430、456；去见姜维 y=500。顶部已完成的推理保持原位置。所有数字基于当前约1672×940的画面。这是真正移动布局和收紧间距，不是仅改变文字大小。

所有文字继续统一小号楷体：线索、解释、选择项用16～17像素字高；当前问题与右侧两个结论都用20像素字高。第一行问题、两侧结果不要大字，所有对话文字保持原内容，不添加任何新文字。

调整连线贴合新位置：右上结论的一条浅色细弧线，终点必须连接到左下固定线索“今夜有变，可能试探”的右边缘，不能连接到问题开头的红色笔痕；绕过问题文字。左下三条线索以三条纤细浅弧线汇聚到右下结果左缘。文字和连线不重叠。保留墨迹形状的线索底纹、朱砂按钮和同样材质的选择栏。

目标：同一条右侧竖轴上连续排列两条小结论，明显更短的上下距离，所有字号小而一致。画幅保持16:9，背景完整保留。

Refine this same UI. Preserve the exact background artwork and all Chinese words. REDRAW the interface geometry more decisively; do not preserve the current misalignment.

MOST IMPORTANT: the two right-hand outcomes must be on ONE EXACT VERTICAL TEXT AXIS. Move the UPPER text “今夜有变，可能试探” RIGHT by 48 pixels so its first character is at the same horizontal coordinate as the lower “向姜维请求接报” (approximately x=998 in this 1672px image). Both outcome ink-wash strips must start at x=968. BOTH outcome glyphs must have exactly the SAME SMALL size: copy the upper outcome's font size onto the lower outcome. Their first characters MUST line up vertically. Do not put the lower text further right. This must be a visible geometry correction, not a near match.

COMPRESS BOTH ROUNDS TOGETHER: move the entire TOP reasoning row group (its 3 input strips, conclusion, and associated lines) DOWN 25px. Move the entire LOWER reasoning group (question, 3 input strips, outcome with supporting text) UP 45px. This brings the two rounds much closer. Within BOTH clue lists use 38px between row centers, not the current 55px. Preserve clear separation between previous round and current question.

Move the “添入线索” and red “推理” controls UP 95px from their current positions, so they sit closely underneath the final current clue with a 24px gap. Move the expanded four-choice selection slip UP 95px with them and reduce its two-row height by 25%, retaining all four choices and plus signs. The lower grouping must become visibly more compact, ending roughly at y=650 instead of y=780. Use the same small Kaishu lettering for all text, with only a slight size increase for the current question and TWO SAME-SIZED outcomes. Keep background scenery perfectly stable.

RESTORE the TWO tiny translucent × remove symbols: one directly after “今夜不得入帐”, one directly after “伯约受命接报”. The mandatory “今夜有变，可能试探” clue has no ×.

Reconnect all thin curved lines to the moved text groups. Do not introduce additional UI, new texts, boxes, ornaments or straight rules. Maintain the same palette, tactile material edges and atmosphere. Final image must show an obvious tight two-round chain with both right outcomes on a shared left alignment.
